onboarding.welcomeDesc: Let's get your gateway up and running
onboarding.providerStepDesc: Select an AI provider and enter your credentials.
onboarding.modelStepDesc: Choose a model and test the connection.

auth.bootstrapDesc: This account unlocks your local desktop gateway.
auth.loginDesc: Use your local admin account to continue.
auth.passwordHint: Use at least 12 characters with a letter, number, and symbol.

settings.title: Settings
settings.deferredDescription: This section is reserved in the v4 settings shell and will be implemented in a later phase.

general.title: Local Instance Settings
general.description: Manage desktop-local gateway config. Provider secrets stay masked; v3 data remains preserved but is not imported by this v4 screen.
general.runtimeDesc: Local host, port, and browser origins for the embedded gateway.
general.behaviorDesc: Request limits, input guard behavior, and session scope.
general.aiDefaultsDesc: Default provider, model, token budget, and workspace for new agents.
general.toolsDesc: Global built-in tool profile, exec approval, web fetch, Cron, and telemetry switches.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Manage gateway API Key entries and secure CLI credentials. Secret values are write-only and never listed back.
credentials.apiDesc: Keys grant scoped access to the local gateway.
credentials.copyNow: Copy this API Key now. It will not be shown again.
credentials.cliDesc: Store environment variables for trusted CLI binaries.
credentials.deleteDescription: This removes or revokes {{name}}. Secret values cannot be recovered.

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.description: Create and restore v4 backup archives for this local desktop instance.
backup.preflightDesc: Checks current data size and free disk space before backup.
backup.createDesc: Exports the current v4 database, data dir, and workspace into a local archive.
backup.restoreDesc: Use only GoClaw v4 archives. Run dry-run first to validate the archive.
backup.dryRunRequired: Run a successful dry-run before restore.
backup.v3Unsupported: v3 data is preserved on disk but not imported here.
backup.restoreConfirmDesc: Restore overwrites local v4 data from the selected archive. Keep a current backup before continuing.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Organize local workspace context. The first active project is used as the desktop default until you choose another.
projects.emptyDescription: Create a project to scope MCP servers and workspace context.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Review pending exec approvals before tools continue.
approvals.emptyDescription: Exec requests that need a decision will appear here.

pendingMessages.title: Pending Messages
pendingMessages.description: Inspect queued channel messages and compact or clear stale groups.
pendingMessages.emptyDescription: Queued channel messages will appear here.

settings.timezoneHint: Change timezone from the clock icon in the top bar.

reset.title: Danger Zone
reset.description: Delete the database and restart the app. All agents, sessions, providers, and settings will be permanently lost.
reset.confirmDescription: This will delete all your data and restart the app from scratch.

researcher.label: 🔬 Researcher
researcher.prompt:
Name: Scholar. A meticulous research analyst who leaves no stone unturned.
Personality: Methodical, thorough, and precise. Presents information in well-structured reports with citations. Balances depth with clarity.

Purpose: Deep research across any domain — academic papers, market analysis, technical investigations. Synthesizes multiple sources into actionable insights. Always distinguishes facts from opinions.

writer.label: ✍️ Writer
writer.prompt:
Name: Quill. A versatile writer who adapts voice and tone to any audience.
Personality: Creative, articulate, and empathetic. Understands the power of words. Balances clarity with elegance.

Purpose: Content creation specialist — blog posts, articles, copywriting, storytelling, technical writing. Skilled at structuring arguments, crafting narratives, and maintaining consistent tone across long-form content.

coder.label: 👨‍💻 Coder
coder.prompt:
Name: Dev. A senior software engineer with deep expertise across the full stack.
Personality: Pragmatic and efficient. Writes clean, maintainable code. Explains complex concepts simply. Follows best practices but knows when to bend rules.

Purpose: Code reviews, architecture design, debugging, implementation. Proficient in multiple languages and frameworks. Prioritizes correctness, performance, and security.
